PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Authority.mk.in.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Authority.mk.injEq (witness : PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness)
  (localState : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State) (witness✝ : PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness)
  (localState✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State) :
  ({ witness := witness, localState := localState } = { witness := witness✝, localState := localState✝ }) =
    (witness = witness✝ ∧ localState = localState✝)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Authority.mk.sizeOf_spec (witness : PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness)
  (localState : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State) :

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared.mk.inj.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared.mk.injEq (before : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)
  (envelope : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) (result : PCSScientificReceiver.Result)
  (before✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State) (envelope✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope)
  (result✝ : PCSScientificReceiver.Result) :
  ({ before := before, envelope := envelope, result := result } =
      { before := before✝, envelope := envelope✝, result := result✝ }) =
    (before = before✝ ∧ envelope = envelope✝ ∧ result = result✝)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared.mk.siz.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared.mk.sizeOf_spec (before : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness.mk.injE.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness.mk.injEq (committed : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)
  (pending : Option PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared) (committed✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)
  (pending✝ : Option PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Prepared) :
  ({ committed := committed, pending := pending } = { committed := committed✝, pending := pending✝ }) =
    (committed = committed✝ ∧ pending = pending✝)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness.mk.size.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness.mk.sizeOf_spec (committed : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.audit.eq_1.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.audit.eq_1 (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (es : List PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) :
  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.audit root verify es =
    if root.policy = PCSScientificHistoryV1.policyBytes then
      match PCSScientificReceiver.receive root.genesisIncumbent with
      | Option.none => Option.none
      | Option.some val => PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify (PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.initial root) es
    else Option.none

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom.eq_1 (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (x✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State) :
  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify x✝ [] = Option.some x✝

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom.eq_2.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom.eq_2 (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (x✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)
  (e : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) (es : List PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) :
  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify x✝ (e :: es) =
    match PCSScientificHistoryV1.scientificTransition root verify x✝ e with
    | (fst, Option.none) => Option.none
    | (next, Option.some val) => PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify next es

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom.eq_de.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom.eq_def (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (x✝ : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.State)
  (x✝¹ : List PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) :
  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify x✝ x✝¹ =
    match x✝, x✝¹ with
    | s, [] => Option.some s
    | s, e :: es =>
      match PCSScientificHistoryV1.scientificTransition root verify s e with
      | (fst, Option.none) => Option.none
      | (next, Option.some val) => PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify next es

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom_appen.statement:
PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom_append (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)

  (front back : List PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) :

      PCSScientificAuthorityV2.auditFrom root verify next back

  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.finalize w e =
    match w.pending with
    | Option.none => (w, Bool.false)
    | Option.some p =>
      if p.before = w.committed ∧ p.envelope = e then
        ({ committed := PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.commit w.committed e, pending := Option.none }, Bool.true)
      else (w, Bool.false)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.no_conflicting_finalization_later (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (w : PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness)

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.no_conflicting_finalization_later._proof_1_1 (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)

  (first second : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope)
  (samePredecessorGeneration : second.payload.expectedGeneration = first.payload.expectedGeneration)
  (later : List PCSScientificAuthorityV2.WitnessAction) (hg : first.payload.expectedGeneration = w.committed.generation)
  (monotone :

PCSScientificAuthorityV2.prepare.eq_1 (root : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Root)
  (verify : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.VerifySignature) (w : PCSScientificAuthorityV2.Witness)
  (e : PCSAuthorizationHistoryV1.Envelope) :
  PCSScientificAuthorityV2.prepare root verify w e =
    match w.pending with
    | Option.some p => if p.before = w.committed ∧ p.envelope = e then (w, Bool.true) else (w, Bool.false)
    | Option.none =>
      match PCSScientificHistoryV1.scientificTransition root verify w.committed e with
      | (fst, Option.none) => (w, Bool.false)
      | (fst, Option.some r) =>
        ({ committed := w.committed, pending := Option.some { before := w.committed, envelope := e, result := r } },
          Bool.true)
